meta.title: Window & Quit (dsh-window-control)
meta.description: Adds a Window & Quit page to DSH settings: choose maximize (keeps the window buttons in the top-right corner) or true fullscreen on launch, then maximize / restore / minimize / always-on-top at any time. Quit with a native confirmation dialog, triggered by Esc, double Esc or Ctrl+Q - Esc leaves fullscreen first. The window channel is installed by the plugin itself, so no extra script or Python is needed; the first install takes effect after two DSH restarts.
